plan: Drive: from Northern Rockies Regional Municipality, about 249 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 59.91127, -126.39319, where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Walk 12 km to the start. Ride: the unnamed road stretch, 3.2 km one way. About 64 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-53, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
